title: Lipid and Glucose Response to Plant-based and Regular Burgers
official: Assessment of Postprandial Response After Consumption of Plant-based Burgers
summary: This study evaluates the blood lipid and glucose response to two burgers: 1) A plant-based meat alternative burger and 2) a regular beef burger in a cross-over trial.

interventions.name: Acute consumption of different burger types

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Body mass index 25 or higher

Exclusion Criteria:

* Not diagnosed with diabetes
* Not on any medications for glucose or lipids

sites.f: College of Kinesiology, University of Saskatchewan
